name: ZERO_COST_FEATURE_SET_V1

required_features.name: goals_for_against
required_features.requirements: completed-only, as-of decision time, home/away aware

required_features.name: home_away
required_features.requirements: canonical team mapping and venue orientation

required_features.name: recent_form
required_features.requirements: rolling window ending strictly before target kickoff

required_features.name: rest_days
required_features.requirements: timezone-aware and computed without future leakage

required_features.name: league_baseline
required_features.source: completed fixtures available before target kickoff
required_features.requirements: competition/season scoped, minimum sample policy declared

optional_features.name: xg_xga
optional_features.use_when: real provider values with explicit provenance are available

optional_features.name: conversion_rate
optional_features.use_when: computed only from observed goals and shots under one declared window

research_only_features.name: ppda
research_only_features.source: open event datasets where the frozen event contract is derivable

research_only_features.name: set_piece_shots
research_only_features.source: open event datasets with deterministic play-pattern/origin fields

research_only_features.name: headed_shots
research_only_features.source: open event datasets with explicit shot body part

invariants: No proxy metric may masquerade as a frozen production metric.
Research-only fields never increase production live completeness.
The existing production completeness formula and 90% threshold are unchanged.
A zero-cost experiment cannot emit a formal production BET by itself.
